lines.zh: 我贴着水边爬，一步一步。
lines.en: I crawl along the water's edge, step by step.

lines.zh: 微光池的光，落在我背上。
lines.en: Light from the glimmer pool falls on my back.

lines.zh: 我六条腿，走得比看上去快。
lines.en: Six legs. Faster than it looks.
I walk on the moss without slipping.
The water shines like glass.
I crawl over. My shadow stays small.
I go from the pool's edge to the far side.
At night I go into the wood too.
I follow the damp on the ground.
I shift toward the glow.
I stop and sweep my antennae.
I shift two steps along the pool.
My shell gleams a little in the light.
A step, a pause. I see better that way.
The pool is very still. I don't touch it.
Dew glints on the leaf tips.
I lie on a stone by the pool.
Light reflects off the water. Dazzling.
The water's flat today. Good.
My antennae never stop moving.
By the glimmer pool, no hunters.
A few like me are down in the pool.
At night there's less light in the wood.

lines.zh: 我慢慢地擦自己的前足。
lines.en: I clean a foreleg slowly.

lines.zh: 水面上的小虫，我不够快。
lines.en: The bugs on the water — I'm not quick enough.
It's stopped moving. Then let it be.
I'll hide under the stone a while.
When it's quiet again, I'll come out.
The moss here is soft.
The glow at the pool's heart is home.
You're crouched by the pool.
Move a bit—I need to dry my wings.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住了我的光。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my light.
I retreat into the glow and hide.

lines.zh: 我的光在石头下闷住了。
lines.en: My glow smothered under the stone.
If you stay still, I'll come out.
I poke half my body out.
You don't look hungry.
You aren't hungry. That's something.
I slip out between your fingers.
Under the stone. I'm still here.
Just not coming closer.
In the glimmer pool, I shine.
I'm on my back, legs kicking.
I squeeze into the crack and hide.
Fluid leaks out. It glows faintly.
I can still move with this.

lines.zh: 光散了一点，我又聚回来。
lines.en: My light scatters a little, then gathers back.
My kin will come.
I right myself slowly.
Don't crush me. I'd break.
I'm not crushed yet.
Is that a soul apple in your hand?
That smell is strange.
By the glimmer pool, I inch forward.
Keep your hand steady.
I've touched it.

lines.zh: 有那么一瞬，我看见了别的东西。
lines.en: For an instant I saw something else.
My body is changing.

lines.zh: 跟着你，我就不是现在这样。
lines.en: If I follow you, I won't be like this.
Changing like this. Fine.

lines.zh: 苹果给了我方向，我跟你走。
lines.en: The apple gave me a direction. I'll follow.
This thing gives off a faint glow.
I crawl a full circle around it.
You bumped me and I flipped.
I flip over and crawl back.
I've righted myself.
You nearly crushed my wings.
The crack is just wide enough to turn in.
Only room for one in here.
The ripples knock me about.
Water on my wings weighs me down.
I back onto dry ground.
I'll move once you've gone.

lines.zh: 池边有很多我们这样的。
lines.en: There are many like us by the pool.

lines.zh: 你也是从这池水里出来的？
lines.en: Did you come out of this pool too?
Our shells are much the same color.
Let's crawl a stretch together.
By the pool, you're faster than me.

lines.zh: 微光池上，两只光慢慢靠近。
lines.en: Over the glow pool, two lights drift together.
Under that stone. We can hide.
Under the stone. We'll press in.
We'll come out at night.
Less light then.

lines.zh: 我用两只小手抱着它飘。
lines.en: I float along hugging it with both little hands.

lines.zh: 微光池边，这东西有点重。
lines.en: By the shimmer pool, this is a little heavy.
I drag it. Can't go fast.

lines.zh: 我用前足抱住，藏到石下。
lines.en: I hug it with my forelegs and hide it under stone.
Yours. I leave it.
I push; it rolls.
There's light on it.

lines.zh: 微光池的夜，我身上在亮。
lines.en: On a glimmer-pool night, I shine.
I nudge it to the pool's edge.
I can't bite it. Leave it.
In the glimmer pool, I flicker once.
I raise my head, antennae out.
That thing on the water is alive.
I know that smell now.
The stone hides me. Good.
Shift a touch closer.
I crawled here and stopped.
I kept low. It hasn't noticed.
I want a closer look at that light.
That one on the water. This one.
In the glimmer pool, I flashed.
I follow the shadow to find it.
I follow it along the pool's edge.
It goes left. I circle left.

lines.zh: 微光池的水面晃了一下。
lines.en: The glimmer pool's surface ripples.
I skate across the water's skin.
In the glimmer pool I look like a star.
Something's moving toward me on the water.
It lowered its head. An opening.
This is the opening.
I shift two inches forward.
Past the stone. Right ahead.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头，一点一点绕。
lines.en: I hug the stone and work my way round.
Its shadow has shifted this way.
I pounce and bite.
Small jaws, but a tight grip.

lines.zh: 它甩了一下，我掉进水里。
lines.en: It shook and I fell into the water.
In water I'm actually quick.
I bump its belly from below.
Swim under. One more bite.
That's the limit of my strength.
I retreat into the crack.

lines.zh: 我往水里一沉就不见了。
lines.en: One dip and I vanish into the pool.
I'm right under here.
I climb out of the pool.
Water still on my shell.
The pool is bright. Around it is dark.
I lie on a stone to recover.
My antennae sweep a full circle.
This smell is familiar.
Kin are calling in the wood.
I crawl that way.
The night glow lights the way.
In the glimmer pool, I light up.
Fire neared and my shell curled.

lines.zh: 我从石头上掉下来，翻了身。
lines.en: I fell off the stone and flipped.

lines.zh: 水里我能待，可这水太深了。
lines.en: I can take water, but this is too deep.
The blast threw me into the pool.
Something pierced my shell.
A flash and my shell went pale.

lines.zh: 池边没虫子了，我越来越轻。
lines.en: No bugs by the pool. I grow lighter.

lines.zh: 雷落在水面上，我全身一麻。
lines.en: Lightning struck the water and I went numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有石头，也没有水。
lines.en: No stones here. No water.
